title: Online Covariance Estimation for Averaged Stochastic Gradient Descent on Riemannian Manifolds
abstract: arXiv:2610.33419v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study online inference for averaged Riemannian stochastic gradient descent (RSGD) when the unknown parameter lies on a manifold. Although the averaged RSGD iterate is asymptotically normal, practical inference requires estimating the unknown covariance operator in its limiting distribution. Existing online batch-means methods cannot be applied directly because a general Riemannian manifold lacks an addition operation, and the tangent space containing the Riemannian gradient varies across iterations. Through vector transport, we construct overlapping and non-overlapping covariance estimators that adaptively combine information from successive batches while accounting for the changing tangent spaces. The proposed estimators are online, require neither Riemannian Hessian computations nor a prespecified terminal sample size, and attain the same convergence rates as their Euclidean counterparts (Zhu et al., 2023). translated_title: 黎曼流形上平均化随机梯度下降的在线协方差估计
translated_abstract: 我们研究了当未知参数位于流形上时，平均化黎曼随机梯度下降（RSGD）的在线推断问题。尽管平均化RSGD迭代具有渐近正态性，但实际推断需要估计其极限分布中未知的协方差算子。现有的在线批均值方法无法直接应用，因为一般的黎曼流形缺乏加法运算，且包含黎曼梯度的切空间在迭代过程中会发生变化。通过向量传输，我们构造了重叠与非重叠协方差估计器，它们能够自适应地融合连续批次的信息，同时处理不断变化的切空间。所提出的估计器是在线的，既不需要计算黎曼Hessian矩阵，也不需要预先指定终止样本量，并且达到了与其欧几里得对应方法相同的收敛速度（Zhu et al., 2023）。结合渐近……
tldr: 本文通过向量传输技术构造了黎曼流形上平均化RSGD的在线协方差估计器，能够自适应处理迭代中变化的切空间，无需计算黎曼Hessian矩阵或预设终止样本量，且收敛速度与欧几里得情形一致。
en_tdlr: This paper constructs online covariance estimators for averaged RSGD on Riemannian manifolds via vector transport, which adaptively handle varying tangent spaces across iterations, require neither Riemannian Hessian computations nor prespecified terminal sample sizes, and attain the same convergence rates as their Euclidean counterparts.
